meta.title: Try to purchase a line on hold

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions screen as the buyer.
Show open purchase requisitions, where purchasable PR lines are selected.

args.goal: select the PR line that is on hold with a remark, hover over Purchase Items and read why it is unavailable, then try to click Purchase Items; verify the held line cannot be purchased and that releasing it requires a remark

steps.note: No catalog domain step can identify a line by its hold state or perform the exact hover-and-click interaction, so execute this buyer-side screen task directly.

args.text: Please fill the remarks to continue!

steps.note: Assert the displayed refusal states that a remark is required before the held line can be released or purchased.
